input_messages.content: Hey, I just got off my weekly phone call with Mom. Man, she can really talk.
How is she doing? Did she have any advice for your apartment hunting tomorrow afternoon with Liwei?
Oh yeah, definitely. She suggested we should only look at places with south-facing windows during the apartment hunting. She's very particular about the sunlight.
Classic mom advice! South-facing windows do get the best light. Did she have any other demands?

Well, she also spent ten minutes complaining about her neighbor's loud parrot while we were discussing the apartment hunting. I had to steer the conversation back. I told her I need to make sure I wear comfortable sneakers for the apartment hunting since we'll be walking around so much tomorrow.

Yeah, I did. I promised Mom I would send her a video tour of every single place we view during the apartment hunting. That finally gave her some peace of mind.

Hey, I just finished syncing with Boss Zhang about the Shenzhen trip.
Nice! How did the sync go? Any roadblocks?
No roadblocks at all. He officially approved the 5000 RMB travel budget for the Shenzhen trip today.
Awesome, that's a relief. It's good to have that locked in before the Double Eleven prep gets too crazy.
For sure. He was actually super relaxed. He even asked if I like eating Cantonese dim sum, since I'm going on the Shenzhen trip.
Haha, that's cool of him! You should definitely try to grab some while you're down there.

I will if I have time. We also chatted about how humid the weather will likely be during the Shenzhen trip, so I'm not looking forward to the sweating. Oh, by the way, I need to buy a new carry-on suitcase for the Shenzhen trip soon.
I hear you on the humidity! I'll make a note to remind you to shop for that new carry-on suitcase before you leave.

Sounds fun! When are you guys hitting the court?
He scheduled it for Saturday night at 8:00 PM. Honestly, my shoulders are already feeling sore just thinking about it.
Make sure to stretch! I've blocked off 8:00 PM tomorrow. Need me to remind you to pack your gear?

That's super convenient! A good roast goose sounds like the perfect way to unwind after a long day. Are you feeling good about the trip overall?
Honestly, no. I ended up expressing some intense anxiety to Sister Chen. I just found out I have to present directly to the VP during the Shenzhen trip, and I'm freaking out a bit.
Ah, man, I get why you're anxious, but you've got this. You've been leading the Double Eleven prep like a pro. Do you want me to help you practice the pitch later?

input_messages.content: Hey! Today's apartment hunting was pretty exhausting. My shoes got really muddy walking around that new development area.
Ugh, muddy shoes are the worst way to end a long day of walking. Did you guys at least see any decent places?
A couple of okay ones, but nothing perfect yet. At least Liwei kept the mood light. She mentioned this really funny dog she saw on the street during the hunt, just rolling around in a pile of leaves.
Haha, that's cute. It's good she was in high spirits! Are you guys still aiming to move by the end of the month?

Actually, I want to accelerate the timeline. I made a serious commitment to Liwei today that I will secure a lease by mid-August during our apartment hunting, instead of the end of August like we originally planned.
Wow, mid-August is coming up fast! That's a big promise. Want me to start blocking off more evenings this week so you can squeeze in extra viewings?
Yeah, let's look at the calendar tomorrow. Anyway, right after the apartment hunting today, we stood on the corner for like ten minutes debating whether to get bubble tea or iced coffee.
The ultimate post-apartment-hunting dilemma! Whatever you chose, you definitely earned it. Let me know when you're ready to schedule those viewings tomorrow.
Hey, I just got off a call with Sister Chen to catch up after the Shenzhen trip. I mentioned to her that I brought back some local snacks from the trip for the team.
Welcome back! I'm sure the team will love the snacks. How was the catch-up with Sister Chen?

It was really nice. She asked if the flight back from the Shenzhen trip was bumpy, which it actually was a bit. But mostly, I just felt a massive wave of relief and exhaustion telling her that my big presentation for the Shenzhen trip was finally over.
I remember how anxious you were about presenting to the VP! It must feel incredible to have that weight off your shoulders. You definitely earned a break.
Exactly, it's such a huge weight off. I also told her that I took a lot of notes on my iPad during the Shenzhen trip, so I have plenty of material to review for our Double Eleven prep.
That's great. Having all those iPad notes will make organizing the action items so much easier. Do you want me to help you sort through them tomorrow?
Yeah, let's tackle that tomorrow. Tonight, I'm just going to relax and enjoy the fact that the hardest part is behind me.
Sounds like the perfect plan. Get some well-deserved rest, Linchen!

I'll make a note to check with the vendor on vegetarian options for the kickoff! How are the rest of the sale preps going?

What's going on? Is this about the Double Eleven prep or something else?

Oh man, that waiting period is always the hardest, especially after you were so relieved to finally find a place. Did Sister Chen have any thoughts on it?
